resources.string: Connect to SMB, WebDAV or SFTP, then browse. Shows up to 200 entries; tap files to download up to 8 MiB. Passwords are not saved. SFTP requires a trusted fingerprint; HTTPS is recommended for WebDAV.
Check protocol and URL. Embedded credentials, query strings and fragments are not allowed.

Authorize a directory through the system picker, including available USB storage. This is not a USB driver. Shows up to 200 entries; downloads are limited to 8 MiB. Reauthorize after removal or permission loss.
Directory grant persisted; permissions are checked for each operation.
Directory restored; browse to check permission.
Create a file in the browsed directory without overwriting existing files. Interruptions may leave a partial file; inspect the destination. Continue?
Create a unique 4 KiB file, read it back, verify it and delete it. Failure may leave the test file; inspect the reported path. Continue?
Showing %1$d of %2$d entries. Browse the destination before uploading or testing.
Verification failed. Check for a remaining test file: %1$s
4 KiB write, read-back comparison and cleanup completed.
